paper_source.citation: Joseph et al., Communications Biology 3, 743 (2020), DOI 10.1038/s42003-020-01471-6
paper_source.inspected_claims: The article describes ENTH placed on POPC with a single PIP2, H0 interaction/insertion, then pulling ENTH away to reach inserted, adsorbed, and solution states; Figure 4 compares H0 secondary structure/helicity. The source available in this inspection does not supply the original system files or enough numeric pulling/restraint details to recreate them unambiguously.

evidence.environment: Per benchmarks/enth/environment.md, GROMACS 2023.3 Ubuntu package build was verified under WSL and a transient systemd service demonstrated CPUQuota=200%, MemoryMax=4G, MemorySwapMax=0 and RuntimeMaxSec. This verifies installation/resource-boundary mechanics only; it does not validate an ENTH system or an MD trajectory.

blockers.item: No original CHARMM-GUI generated system or archived simulation files supplied
blockers.detail: Missing processed coordinates, topology/includes and CHARMM36 parameter provenance; initial/equilibration structures; production inputs; original pulling setup and state trajectory/frame definitions.

The benchmark protocol transcribes the publication as 0.15 mM. This is unusual for physiological ionic strength, but must not be changed to 0.15 M without source confirmation. This choice affects ion count and system composition.

blockers.item: H0 residue mapping is not defined in supplied inputs
blockers.detail: Need the exact construct/chain and residue-number mapping from 1H0A to the simulated ENTH construct, including treatment of missing/renumbered residues and the precise residues used for helicity.

blockers.item: Pulling protocol and state boundaries are unspecified locally
blockers.detail: Need pulling axis/reference groups, spring constant, initial/final coordinates or schedule, rate/trajectory, and objective criteria/time windows for inserted, adsorbed, and solvent states.

blockers.item: PIP2 chemical model is unspecified locally
blockers.detail: Need exact PIP2 lipid species, protonation/charge state, CHARMM36 parameter/topology version, and any restraints or placement constraints.

blockers.item: Pilot enforcement gates remain incomplete for launching MD
blockers.detail: Although the WSL systemd CPU/memory/time boundary is reported verified, this preparation attempt did not establish executable aggregate artifact-size, atom-count, step-count, and call-ledger enforcement around a molecular workflow.

next_minimum_executable_experiment: Obtain the original CHARMM-GUI GROMACS package and source trajectory/metadata for one published configuration, including topology/includes, coordinates, equilibration/restart, MDPs, pull code/parameters, and state-frame annotations; resolve the 0.15 mM KCl value with the source; establish 1H0A chain/residue-to-H0 mapping and PIP2 species/protonation. Then preflight topology/parameter completeness and enforce the documented CPU, memory, wall-time, atom, step, aggregate-output, and single-simulation caps before one ≤50,000-step 2-fs continuation/smoke trajectory. Validate finite energies, constraints, temperature, pressure/volume, and membrane integrity before analysis. This experiment would test workflow execution only, not reproduce Figure 4's biological conclusion.
